# Differential 

| Diagnosis                   | Pt                                                                        | US                                   |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Mittelschmerz               | midcycle pain                                                             | n/a                                  |
| Ectopic pregnancy           | amenorrhea, pain, bleed<br>+bhCG                                          | no intrauterine pregnancy            |
| Ovarian torsion             | sudden unilateral lower abd pain; nausea, vomiting<br>tender adnexal mass | enlarged ovary, decreased blood flow |
| Ruptured ovarian cyst       | sudden unilateral lower abd pain after strenuous/sexual activity          | pelvic free fluid                    |
| Pelvic inflammatory disease | fever/chills, discharge, abd pain, **cervical motion tenderness**         | $\pm$ tubo-ovarian abscess           |
